sources.name: HPLT v3 Lao (lao_Laoo)
sources.notes: Approved as bounded, provenance-recorded Lao training/model-development text input under the project policy. HPLT states that it licenses the dataset packaging under CC0 but does not own the underlying extracted text; downstream users remain responsible for applicable rights. Do not use sampled lines as public capture-pack source text or benchmark ground truth unless the underlying source is independently cleared.

sources.name: KhamLao MOE textbook-derived corpus/images
sources.notes: The repository is MIT, but its corpus pipeline states that it harvests Lao MOE textbooks. The repository license does not establish redistribution rights for the underlying textbook content. Do not ingest until those source rights are independently clarified.

sources.name: Lao-SABAIDEE
sources.notes: The dataset catalog lists about 500 Lao handwritten samples but no public download link and no clear redistribution license. Revisit only if an authoritative source and license become available.

sources.name: NayanaOCR Corpus 2025
sources.notes: Large synthetic multilingual OCR corpus, but its noncommercial terms do not match this project's permissive/commercial-friendly data policy. The published configs also do not provide a Lao-specific dataset path for our target.
